headline: Endurance Technologies posts 21% jump in Q2 net profit
hook: Strong auto demand drives double-digit gains
summary: Endurance Technologies reported a 20.7 percent year-on-year increase in net profit to Rs 274.3 crore for the second quarter. Revenue climbed 33.6 percent to Rs 4,786.2 crore, while EBITDA rose 17.2 percent to Rs 559 crore. However, operating margins compressed by 160 basis points to 11.7 percent due to cost pressures. Indian retail investors tracking auto ancillaries can gauge sector volume health and margin trends from these figures.
why_it_matters: Auto ancillary margins compress despite strong revenue growth.
winners_losers: Endurance holders gain / margin pressures weigh

headline: Kotak Institutional Equities adds five midcap stocks to model portfolio
hook: Kotak Equities bets on five battered midcaps
summary: Kotak Institutional Equities has updated its model portfolio by adding five mid-cap stocks that recently experienced price declines of up to 16%. The new additions include Aster DM Healthcare, Dixon Technologies, Emcure Pharmaceuticals, and Endurance Technologies. These stocks were selected based on their growth potential despite recent market volatility. This move signals institutional interest in specific mid-cap names currently trading at lower valuations.
why_it_matters: Institutional buying may signal potential recovery for these specific midcap stocks.
winners_losers: Selected midcaps gain / No clear losers
